evidence_paraphrase: Project Zenith sought program partnerships in 2020. Horizon privately proposed a company acquisition October 29 and increased its nonbinding price in November; other parties did not propose a company acquisition. Draft merger terms were negotiated, but Horizon stopped all discussions before its December 17 supply-disruption announcement. Parties agreed December 22 to revisit after the January conference and resumed January 18. Viela approved and signed January 31 and first publicly announced February 1 before Nasdaq trading. January 1 therefore falls in paused private negotiations, before an executed or publicly definitive control agreement.
